M/S Cremica Food Industries Ltd. Noida ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. 
Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 5 September, 2024
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:61126-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 6632 of 2024
Petitioner :- M/S Cremica Food Industries Ltd. Noida Thru. Authorized Person Mr. Ram Awa
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Of Energy Civil Secrt. Lko. A
Counsel for Petitioner :- Aditya Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Neerav Chitravanshi 
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra, J. 
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel, who appears for the State-opposite parties. 
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has pointed out the earlier order passed by this Court on 02.08.2024. 
3. We have gone through the order dated 02.08.2024, which is being quoted below:-
M/S Cremica Food Industries Ltd. Noida ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 5 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132618366/
1 "Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents. This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with the following main prayers:-
"I. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned order dated 28.05.2024, passed by the Respondent no.2 as contained in the Annexure no.1, so far as it relates to the adjustment of the electricity duty deposited by the Petitioner before 21.01.2020. 
II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties to refund the Electricity duty amounting to Rs. 789565.00 to the Petitioner, which was collected after the notification dated 21.01.2010 and in reference pay the interest of 10% as prescribed by Hon'ble Apex Court for the period of February 2010 till January 2020."
Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance upon the Judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Uttar Pradesh Vs. M/s Bansal Wire Industries Ltd. and others,
SLP (C) Nos.29175-19178 of 2010 decided on 7.1.2020. It has been submitted that the petitioner had applied for refund but instead giving refund as directed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court, the respondent no.2 has sent a letter dated 28.5.2024 to the Senior Manager of Noida Power Company Ltd. directing adjustment, which is impermissible in terms of the order passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court. 
Learned Standing Counsel has placed before this Court copy of the instructions dated 1.8.2024 sent by the Director, Electrical Safety, U.P. wherein it has been stated that after the letter dated 28.5.2024, the petitioner has submitted an application dated 16.7.2024 which has been considered and a letter has been issued to the Senior Manager, Noida Power Company Ltd. on 31.7.2024 recommending refund to be given to the petitioner of the electricity dues. Copy of such letter dated 31.7.2024 has been enclosed along with the said instructions. 
Instructions are kept on record. 
List this matter on 23.8.2024 as fresh. 
In the meantime, a definite decision shall be taken by the respondents with regard to refund as is admissible to the petitioner."
4. Learned Standing Counsel has produced before this Court the instructions dated 22.08.2024 sent by one Girish Kumar Singh, Director, Electrical Safety, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow-opposite party no.2,
wherein it has been stated that the reimbursement proceedings have been initiated and recommendation dated 12.08.2024 has been received on 20.08.2024 and by letter dated 21.08.2014, the Deputy General Manager, Noida Power Company Limited, Greater Noida has been asked to reimburse Rs.7,89,238/- to the petitioner. A copy of the order dated 21.08.2024 has been enclosed with the said instructions, which is addressed to the Deputy General Manager M/S Cremica Food Industries Ltd. Noida ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 5 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132618366/
2 (Commercial), Noida Power Company Limited. 
5. Instructions are kept on record. 
6. Writ petition stands disposed of. 
. 
(Brij Raj Singh, J.) (Sangeeta Chandra, J.) Order Date :- 5.9.2024 Rao/-
